title: OpenEXR legacy Python channel out-of-bounds write
summary: The upstream advisory documents an out-of-bounds write while decoding image channels through the legacy Python bindings. It explicitly attributes the finding to Anthropic using Claude and validation to an Ada Logics researcher; consequences depend on processing untrusted files.
ai_role: The upstream advisory says Anthropic found the issue using Claude and an Ada Logics researcher validated it.
classification_note: Public upstream disclosure; unknown zero-day status is not inferred.
remediation_note: The advisory lists corrected branch releases 3.3.15, 3.4.17 and 3.5.3. A documented fix does not establish deployment or current safety.

impacts.conditions: Processing an untrusted image with affected legacy Python bindings.
impacts.exploitation: The source reports a technical effect and researcher validation; no observed malicious exploitation is established by this review.
